from config_reader import read_settings

class TestReadSettings(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_basic_valid_config(self):
        text = "endpoint=https://example.com\nenabled=true"
        expected = {'endpoint': 'https://example.com', 'enabled': True}
        self.assertEqual(read_settings(text), expected)

    def test_whitespace_and_comments(self):
        text = """
# This is a comment
endpoint =   https://test.com  
enabled = false # Another comment
    
    """
        expected = {'endpoint': 'https://test.com', 'enabled': False}
        self.assertEqual(read_settings(text), expected)

    def test_required_keys_missing(self):
        text = "endpoint=https://example.com"
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Missing required key: enabled"):
            read_settings(text)

    def test_required_keys_missing_endpoint(self):
        text = "enabled=True"
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Missing required key: endpoint"):
            read_settings(text)

    def test_duplicate_keys(self):
        text = "endpoint=a\nenabled=true\nendpoint=b"
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Duplicate key found: endpoint"):
            read_settings(text)

    def test_malformed_line_no_equals(self):
        text = "endpoint=value\njusta_line"
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Malformed line: missing '='"):
            read_settings(text)

    def test_invalid_enabled_value(self):
        text = "endpoint=https://example.com\nenabled=yes"
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Invalid value for enabled: yes"):
            read_settings(text)

    def test_endpoint_with_whitespace(self):
        text = "endpoint =  url with spaces  \nenabled=true"
        expected = {'endpoint': 'url with spaces', 'enabled': True}
        self.assertEqual(read_settings(text), expected)

    def test_all_ignored_lines(self):
        text = """
# comment 1
  
  # comment 2
"""
        # This test should fail if required keys are not present, which is correct behavior
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Missing required key: endpoint"):
            read_settings(text)
            
    def test_valid_config_with_various_whitespace(self):
        text = """
  endpoint=  url/path  
enabled= True 
"""
        expected = {'endpoint': 'url/path', 'enabled': True}
        self.assertEqual(read_settings(text), expected)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
